row.notes: Shared base view-model vtable slot 23 (cell 0x1457497f8 = 0x145749740+0xb8 in the race strategy panel garage_monitor_panel_race_stratergy, and the same slot in dozens of other panel/tab vtables from 0x1456e1328 to 0x145746528). 5-byte E9 jmp to the .data1 body 0x14aed9000: sets bit 1 of byte vm+0x628 and, when bit 0 is set, tail-jumps 0x1414bf4e0 (thunk to 0x14aecd5f0), which acts only when (flags & 0xc) == 8: sets bit 2, dispatches 'enable' (when bit 4 is set), 'goto_already_open' and 'selected' through Ne_UiEvent_DispatchByName, then vcall +0xc0 (slot 24). So it requests the select/open step of a tab view model; the red-flag-pit addon sets flags (x & ~4) | 9 on the strategy panel and calls it to force the panel to re-select. One argument (rcx), no return value. Class name from the shared base slot (Vm_Construct_TabViewModel 0x1414bdac0 is the neighbouring constructor). Signature: E9 + filler bytes after the protector thunk (build-specific, as other *_Thunk records); make's 96-byte search stops at the undecodable filler byte 1E, so the 16-byte pattern was written by hand and checked unique with sigcheck.find_all. Strings: enable 0x14565f10f, goto_already_open 0x1456e9a3d, selected 0x1456f8a36.
